newsitem.title: USA: Health Management to restate Q1,Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: Health Management to restate Q1,Q2 results.

text.p: Health Management Inc said Monday it plans to restate its financial statements for the first and second quarters of its 1997 fiscal year, take a charge against fiscal third quarter earnings and is renegotiating a proposed transaction with Transworld Home HealthCare Inc.
The restatement will correct certain errors relating to costs of goods sold, which were previously understated by about $1.8 million and $800,000, respectively, the company said in a statement.

Health Management also said it plans to take a charge of about $13 million in the third quarter of 1997, which includes a writeoff of about $2.8 million in goodwill and other costs associated with the sale of the Baltimore retail pharmacies and a writedown of about $10 million in accounts receivable.
Health Management said it will report substantial operating losses for its fiscal third quarter ended January 31, 1997 and for the nine months then ended.
The company said it expects to file on or before March 24, amended documents with the Securities and Exchange Commission covering the restatements.
Health Management also said that it is currently in discussions with Transworld Home Healthcare Inc regarding a renegotiated deal.

In mid-January, Transworld Home announced it completed the purchase of about nine million shares, or about 49 percent, of Health Management stock. Health Management also granted Transworld Home an option to acquire up to an additional two percent of its common stock.

In another development, Health Management said that a March 14, 1997 hearing for final approval of an amended settlement agreement relating to a stockholder class action lawsuit was adjourned until April 11, 1997. The settlement relates to suits filed a year ago. The suits charged that the company and certain directors allegedly violated federal securities laws by misrepresenting and concealing facts about the company's accounts receivables and inventories.

Health Management provides pharmacy management services to patients with chronic medical conditions and to health care professionals, pharmaceutical manufacturers and third-party payers involved in their care.
Trading in shares of Health Management was halted pending an announcement.
